### **User description** [TT-15953] fix: Make EnforceOrgDataAge respect EnforceOrgQuotas configuration (#7434)
TT-15953
Summary Hybrid Gateway hangs for all client requests when MDCB connection is lost
Type Bug
Status In Dev
Points N/A
Labels 2025_r5_candidate, AI-Complexity-High, AI-Priority-High, customer_bug, jira_escalated, stability_theme_reliability
--- ### **User description** ## Summary When RPC storage engine is used (MDCB deployments), `EnforceOrgDataAge` was previously hardcoded to `true`, causing blocking RPC calls in the critical request path during analytics recording. This PR makes `EnforceOrgDataAge` conditional on the `EnforceOrgQuotas` configuration flag. ## Problem In MDCB deployments with analytics enabled: - `EnforceOrgDataAge` is forced to `true` regardless of user configuration - Analytics recording calls `OrgSessionExpiry()` in the request thread - `OrgSessionExpiry()` makes blocking RPC calls to MDCB - When MDCB is unavailable or network issues occur, requests timeout - Cache expires every 10 minutes, causing periodic latency spikes This affects **all** requests, including keyless APIs, because the blocking call happens during analytics recording. ## Solution Make `EnforceOrgDataAge` respect the existing `EnforceOrgQuotas` configuration flag: - Users can now set `enforce_org_quotas: false` to disable blocking RPC calls - This prevents request timeouts when MDCB is unavailable - Maintains backward compatibility (default behavior unchanged) ## Changes Modified `/gateway/api_loader.go` in two locations where RPC storage engine is initialized: - Line ~616: Added conditional check for `EnforceOrgQuotas` before setting `EnforceOrgDataAge` - Line ~929: Same conditional check in the second initialization path ## Impact - **Users with MDCB + analytics enabled**: Can now disable org data age enforcement to prevent request blocking - **Default behavior**: Unchanged - `EnforceOrgQuotas` defaults to `true`, maintaining current behavior - **Performance**: Eliminates 10-minute latency spikes when `enforce_org_quotas: false` is set ## Testing - Verified code compiles successfully - No existing tests affected (gateway package tests pass) - Manual testing recommended for MDCB deployments ## Related Issues Fixes #7429 **Note**: This is a quick fix to give users control over the blocking behavior. Long-term architectural improvements are tracked in: - #7432 - Remove blocking RPC calls from request path - #7433 - Improve DNS change detection efficiency 🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code) ___ ### **PR Type** Bug fix, Enhancement ___ ### **Description** - Respect org data age user intent - Gate enforcement behind org quotas - Prevent forced RPC expiry checks - Duplicate init path aligned ___ ### Diagram Walkthrough ```mermaid flowchart LR RPCInit["RPC storage init paths"] -- "check EnforceOrgQuotas" --> Decision["Quotas enabled?"] Decision -- "Yes" --> Enable["Set EnforceOrgDataAge=true (spec+gw)"] Decision -- "No" --> Skip["Do not override EnforceOrgDataAge"] Result["Fewer blocking RPC calls"] --- Enable Result --- Skip ```
